required_elements.criterion: Father is hostage beside kidnapper; wealthy daughter is free on the other end, begging for father's life.
Demand that she bring ransom alone makes father fear the kidnapper will kill both to eliminate witnesses.
He opposes payment/arrival to protect his daughter, his only family, even at risk to himself; this is his feared outcome, not a reported double murder.

acceptance: All causal narrative elements required, faithful paraphrases accepted. No arbitrary exact wording, names, counts or narrative decoration beyond rubric. Never give solver missing elements. False/incomplete final gets no and game continues.
